originalTitle: Anthropic revenue surges to $16.8bn ahead of stock market listing
summary: It comes as the AI giant is expected to make a blockbuster stock market debut by the end of the year.
content:
Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei

Artificial intelligence (AI) giant Anthropic saw its revenue surge by 45% to $16.8bn (£12.7bn) in the three months to the end of September, the BBC understands.

The figures were reportedly revealed by the Claude-developer as it briefed prospective investors on Wednesday at its headquarters in San Francisco as it lays the groundwork for what is expected to be a blockbuster share sale by the end of the year.

It comes as some tech stocks, including firms that make the chips and other hardware that power data centres, have come under pressure over concerns about the large amounts of money being spent on AI infrastructure.

An Anthropic spokesperson declined to comment.

Anthropic's revenue has risen in successive quarters this year, from $4.7bn in the first three months to $11.6bn the following period.

Its revenue figures, along with those of rival OpenAI, offer an important gauge of the AI industry's growth and ability to finance the infrastructure needed to develop the technology.

The ChatGPT-developer is also eyeing a bumper stock market listing, which is expected to value the firm at more than $1tn.

But OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman said in September that his company will not go public this year as it addresses concerns about the technology's safety.
chineseTitle: 上市前 Anthrotic 营收飙升至 168 亿美元
chineseSummary: 与此同时，这家人工智能巨头预计将在今年年底前在股市首次亮相。
chineseContent:
Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫代 (Dario Amodei)

据英国广播公司了解，截至 9 月底的三个月内，人工智能 (AI) 巨头 Anthropic 的收入猛增 45%，达到 168 亿美元（127 亿英镑）。

据报道，这家克劳德开发商周三在旧金山总部向潜在投资者介绍了这些数字，为预计在年底前进行的大规模股票出售奠定了基础。

与此同时，一些科技股，包括制造芯片和其他数据中心硬件的公司，因担心人工智能基础设施投入大量资金而面临压力。

Anthropic 发言人拒绝发表评论。

Anthropic 今年的收入连续几个季度增长，从前三个月的 47 亿美元增至接下来的一个时期的 116 亿美元。

其收入数据以及竞争对手 OpenAI 的收入数据，提供了衡量人工智能行业增长以及为开发技术所需的基础设施提供资金的能力的重要指标。

ChatGPT 开发商还着眼于在股市上市，预计该公司的估值将超过 1 万亿美元。

但 OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 在 9 月份表示，他的公司今年不会上市，因为它会解决对该技术安全性的担忧。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
